million.sentenceEn: In Los Angeles, California, an ambitious project to go a step further and synchronize(使同步) every red light in Los Angeles cost over 400 million dollars.

million.sentenceEn: Dubbed the Darwin Tree of Life Project, it is expected to take 10 years and cost £100 million .

mental.sentenceEn: In Western countries, at least—poor mental health is more detrimental to wellbeing than poverty.
mental.translationZh: 至少在西方国家，心理健康不佳比贫困对幸福感的危害更大。
mental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

mental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

mental.sentenceEn: To create this kind of widespread passion, learning leaders must expose the workforce to what could be, which will enable them to rethink their mental models, enable them to break free from their deep-rooted paradigms and embrace the opportunity to learn.

mental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

mental.sentenceEn: The WHO recommends establishing institutions that facilitate community participation—educational programs and interventions that provide skills for promoting mental wellbeing.

mental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

mental.sentenceEn: Why does the WHO feel the need to appeal to the economic benefits of improving mental health to justify its recommendations?

major.sentenceEn: There are at least four major problems with work in America today.

mass.sentenceEn: With cities across the world growing rapidly, how will the current urban generation respond to the inevitable social changes of mass urbanisation?
mass.translationZh: 随着全球城市快速发展，当前的城市一代将如何应对大规模城市化带来的必然社会变革？
mass.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

mass.sentenceEn: Born from the accessibility of mass air travel, modern international tourism has been popularized as "holiday-making" in regions that offer comparative advantages of sand, sun and sea.
mass.translationZh: 随着大众航空旅行的普及，现代国际旅游业在那些拥有沙滩、阳光和海洋比较优势的地区兴起，并被广泛称为"度假休闲"。
mass.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

mass.sentenceEn: Mass production of cars made it possible for ordinary people to buy them.
mass.translationZh: 汽车的大规模生产使得普通人也能买得起车。

mass.sentenceEn: It has entered the sixth mass extinction.
mass.translationZh: 地球已进入第六次大规模灭绝时期。

marine.sentenceEn: In May 2016, a salvor named Bobby Pritchett, president of Global Marine Exploration (GME) in Tampa, Florida, announced that he had discovered scattered remains of a ship buried a kilometer off Cape Canaveral.
marine.translationZh: 2016年5月，佛罗里达州坦帕市全球海洋探索公司（GME）总裁、打捞员鲍比·普里切特宣布，他在卡纳维拉尔角外一公里处发现了一艘沉船的散落残骸。

marine.sentenceEn: As technology renders the seabed more accessible, the hunt for treasure-filled ships has drawn a fresh tide of salvors(打捞人员) and their investors—as well as marine archaeologists(考古学家) wanting to bring to light the lost relics.
marine.translationZh: 随着技术使海底更易于探测，对满载宝藏船只的搜寻吸引了新一波打捞人员及其投资者——还有希望让这些失落遗迹重见天日的海洋考古学家。

marine.sentenceEn: In 2017, Derek Loftis of the Virginia Institute of Marine Science started a project called Catch the King.
marine.translationZh: 2017年，弗吉尼亚海洋科学研究所的德里克·洛夫蒂斯启动了一个名为“捕捉国王”的项目。
marine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

marine.sentenceEn: In 2012, for instance, Spain won a five-year legal battle against Odyssey Marine Exploration, which had hauled 594,000 gold and silver coins from a Spanish wreck off the coast of Portugal across the Atlantic to the United States.
marine.translationZh: 例如，2012年，西班牙赢得了一场长达五年的法律诉讼，被告方是奥德赛海洋勘探公司，该公司曾从葡萄牙海岸附近的一艘西班牙沉船上打捞出59.4万枚金银币，并将其跨越大西洋运往美国。

marine.sentenceEn: Salvors of treasures in sunken ships and marine archaeologists are now hostile to each other.
marine.translationZh: 沉船宝藏打捞人员与海洋考古学家如今彼此敌对。

marine.sentenceEn: Complete the series of marine reserves around its coast.
marine.translationZh: 完成澳大利亚沿海一系列海洋保护区的建设

means.sentenceEn: But while a sustainable economy is vital to our future, it is a means to an end, not an end in itself.
means.translationZh: 然而，尽管可持续经济对我们的未来至关重要，但它终究是一种手段而非目的。
means.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

means.sentenceEn: But, as the machine-learning Captcha demonstrates, a significant proportion of digital tech now sees (and uses) humans as means to ends that are not ours.
means.translationZh: 但是，正如机器学习验证码所展示的那样，如今很大一部分数字技术正将人类视为实现非人类自身目的的手段。
means.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第5句

means.sentenceEn: Towards this end, Jackson transferred by means of a deed ownership of the tree and a little land around it to the tree itself.
means.translationZh: 为实现这一目的，杰克逊通过契约将这棵树及其周围一小块土地的所有权转让给了树本身。

means.sentenceEn: It is reasonable to conclude that spending is praiseworthy, supposing it is not beyond your means .
means.translationZh: 如果消费不超出自己的经济能力，那么认为消费值得称赞是合理的。
means.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第9句

means.sentenceEn: In fact, he is a longtime advocate of trans-humanism—the effort to improve the human condition, and even human nature itself, through technological means .
means.translationZh: 事实上，他长期以来一直是超人类主义的倡导者——即通过技术手段改善人类生存状况，甚至改变人类本性的努力。
means.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

means.sentenceEn: It is a necessary means to improve their understanding of scientific issues.
means.translationZh: 这是提高公众对科学问题理解的必要手段。

male.sentenceEn: Women who have children begin to see their salaries slip behind their male counterparts.
male.translationZh: 生育子女的女性开始发现自己的薪资落后于男性同行。
male.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

male.sentenceEn: On the contrary, decades of research shows that female candidates raise as much money and win as often as male politicians with similar credentials.
male.translationZh: 相反，数十年的研究表明，在资历相似的情况下，女性候选人募集的资金与男性政客相当，当选率也不相上下。
male.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

male.sentenceEn: Gender inequality in science is often attributed to the fact that senior academics are more likely to be male , because historically science was male-dominated: it's argued that as time goes on and more women rise to senior roles, the field will become more equal.
male.translationZh: 科学界的性别不平等常常被归因于资深学者更可能是男性这一事实，因为从历史上看，科学领域一直由男性主导：有人认为，随着时间推移以及更多女性晋升到高级职位，该领域将变得更加平等。
male.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

male.sentenceEn: The differences were even starker in the neuroscience journals: 70% of editors were male , and men held the majority of editorial positions in 88% of journals.
male.translationZh: 神经科学期刊的差异更为显著：70%的编辑为男性，且88%的期刊中男性占据了大多数编辑职位。
male.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

male.sentenceEn: What do most males devote much of their energy to during adolescence?
male.translationZh: 青春期的大多数男性会将大量精力投入到什么事情上？

male.sentenceEn: Strike a balance between male and female editors.
male.translationZh: 实现男女编辑比例平衡

manufacturer.sentenceEn: This year, the French government began requiring tech manufacturers to list a repairability score.
manufacturer.translationZh: 今年，法国政府开始要求科技制造商标注产品的可维修性评分。
manufacturer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

manufacturer.sentenceEn: Manufacturers don't talk much about this when they announce the big new thing that will replace your mostly just as good old thing.
manufacturer.translationZh: 当制造商们发布新款产品宣称将要取代你那台其实还很好用的旧设备时，他们很少提及这一点。
manufacturer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

manufacturer.sentenceEn: "It is so easy for manufacturers to generate more of that stuff, rather than even try to recycle, but I believe there is a public interest here: perception is changing so much that companies are starting to look at how they can properly recycle these bottles."
manufacturer.translationZh: 制造商们很容易就能生产出更多这样的东西，而不是尝试回收利用，但我相信这里存在着公共利益：公众观念正在发生巨大变化，以至于企业开始研究如何才能恰当地回收这些瓶子。
manufacturer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

manufacturer.sentenceEn: If it is, then you can easily send it back to the manufacturer , and they'll send you a brand-new one for free surely.
manufacturer.translationZh: 如果还在保修期内的话，你完全可以把它寄回给厂商，他们肯定会免费给你换一台全新的。
manufacturer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

manufacturer.sentenceEn: What does the author say absence claims labels will do to food manufacturers ?
manufacturer.translationZh: 作者认为“无添加”标签会对食品制造商产生什么影响？

manufacturer.sentenceEn: Manufacturers use effective strategies to promote fancier products.
manufacturer.translationZh: 制造商运用有效策略来推广更花哨的产品。

motivate.sentenceEn: They find it pleasurable, and pleasure is evolution's way of motivating us toward adaptive behaviour.
motivate.translationZh: 他们觉得这很愉快，而愉悦是进化促使我们做出适应性行为的方式。
motivate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

motivate.sentenceEn: Meaning was measured through a daily "purpose index", which explored the extent to which participants felt that they like what they do every day and are motivated to achieve their goals.
motivate.translationZh: 意义感通过每日"目标指数"来衡量，该指数考察参与者在多大程度上享受他们每天所做的事情，并有为实现目标而努力的动力。
motivate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

motivate.sentenceEn: As a result, they regard these individuals with greater trust and mutual understanding, which motivates them to seek further opportunities for collaboration.
motivate.translationZh: 因此，他们会给予这些人更多的信任和相互理解，这促使他们寻求更多的合作机会。
motivate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

motivate.sentenceEn: While these attacks are motivated by misguided ideas, we need to do a better job of explaining why these claims are false and why what we do is valuable.
motivate.translationZh: 尽管这些抨击源于一些错误的观念，但我们仍需更好地阐明为何这些说法与事实不符，以及我们所做工作的价值所在。
motivate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

motivate.sentenceEn: What has motivated the man to write his books?
motivate.translationZh: 是什么促使这位男士撰写他的书籍？

motivate.sentenceEn: People feel positive about their work as long as they are motivated .
motivate.translationZh: 只要人们受到激励，就会对自己的工作产生积极感受。

moral.sentenceEn: These seven moral rules appear to be universal across cultures, because people face the same social problems.
moral.translationZh: 这七条道德准则似乎在各种文化中都具有普遍性，因为人们面临着相同的社会问题。
moral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

moral.sentenceEn: "Everyone everywhere shares a common moral code," said Dr. Oliver Scott Curry, lead author and senior researcher at Oxford.
moral.translationZh: 牛津大学资深研究员、该研究的主要作者奥利弗·斯科特·柯里博士表示：“世界各地的人们都共享一套共同的道德准则。”
moral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

moral.sentenceEn: The study published in Current Anthropology is the largest and most comprehensive and widespread survey of morals ever conducted and aimed to find out whether different societies had different versions of morality.
moral.translationZh: 发表在《当代人类学》上的这项研究是迄今为止规模最大、最全面且最广泛的道德观念调查，旨在探究不同社会是否存在不同版本的道德体系。
moral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

moral.sentenceEn: The huge study of 60 different cultures around the world found that all communities operate under seven basic moral codes.
moral.translationZh: 这项针对全球60种不同文化的大规模研究发现，所有社群都遵循七种基本道德准则。
moral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

moral.sentenceEn: People who regularly express gratitude can benefit in moral terms.
moral.translationZh: 经常表达感恩的人可以在道德层面受益。

moral.sentenceEn: All societies are kept together by seven basic moral rules.
moral.translationZh: 所有社会都是靠七条基本道德准则维系在一起的。

movement.sentenceEn: Along with a couple of classmates, Charlene did a quick web search and discovered a small but growing movement led by the organization, Herbicide-Free Campus (HFC), to rid college campuses of artificial herbicides(灭草剂).
movement.translationZh: 沙琳和几位同学一起快速搜索了网络，发现了一个由“无除草剂校园”(HFC)组织领导的小型但正在发展壮大的运动，旨在清除大学校园中的人工除草剂。
movement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

movement.sentenceEn: When she discovered the HFC movement , she said she felt she "had found a specific area to focus on that still fit into the larger picture of fighting for a healthier, safer, cleaner environment for all."
movement.translationZh: 当她发现氢氟碳化物(HFC)运动时，她说自己感到“找到了一个可以专注的特定领域，而这一领域仍然契合为所有人争取更健康、更安全、更清洁环境的大图景。”
movement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

movement.sentenceEn: "Mise-en-place forces cooks to account for every minute of their time and every movement . Every component of one single dish is in one single corner, so their hand literally moves inches," explains Dwayne Lipuma, an instructor at the culinary institute of America.
movement.translationZh: 美国烹饪学院讲师德韦恩·利普uma解释道：“‘各就各位’的准备工作迫使厨师们必须精确计算每一分钟的时间和每一个动作。一道菜的所有食材都放在一个固定区域，这样厨师的手实际上只需移动几英寸的距离。”
movement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

movement.sentenceEn: The conversation couldn't be heard but could be detected through mouth movements .
movement.translationZh: 虽然听不到谈话内容，但可以通过口型察觉到。
movement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

movement.sentenceEn: Modelled on the movements of a MasterChef contest winner, Tim Anderson, its robotic arms are fixed over a stove and programmed to prepare dishes from raw ingredients.
movement.translationZh: 其机械臂模仿了《顶级厨师》冠军蒂姆·安德森的动作，固定在炉灶上方，并可通过编程从原始食材开始烹饪菜肴。

movement.sentenceEn: What did Loftis and his colleagues do to obtain data about water height and movement ?
movement.translationZh: 洛夫蒂斯和他的同事们做了什么来获取有关水位和水流运动的数据？

massive.sentenceEn: Apparently, they did a massive renovation a few years ago.
massive.translationZh: 据了解，他们在几年前进行了一次大规模翻修。
massive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第3句

massive.sentenceEn: W: The massive glass windows make all the difference.
massive.translationZh: 大面积的玻璃窗确实起到了决定性的作用。
massive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

massive.sentenceEn: Perhaps the countryside should also prepare itself for massive population increases in the future.
massive.translationZh: 或许农村地区也应该为未来的人口大幅增长做好准备。
massive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

massive.sentenceEn: Imagine sitting down to a big dinner: a massive steak, a large portion of fried potatoes, and cake for dessert.
massive.translationZh: 想象一下，你坐下来享用一顿丰盛的晚餐：一大块牛排、一大份炸土豆，还有蛋糕作为甜点。
massive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

massive.sentenceEn: What occurs to many people when they see the massive bones in the pit wall?
massive.translationZh: 当许多人看到坑壁中大量的骨头时，他们会想到什么？

massive.sentenceEn: They are widely applicable for massive open online courses.
massive.translationZh: 它们广泛适用于大规模开放在线课程。

meanwhile.sentenceEn: Meanwhile , the average child with even just one unexcused absence does much worse academically than peers with none.
meanwhile.translationZh: 与此同时，即使只有一次无故缺课的普通儿童，其学业表现也比从未缺课的同龄人差得多。
meanwhile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

meanwhile.sentenceEn: Since ancient times, meanwhile , people have been aware of a link between isolation and mental focus.
meanwhile.translationZh: 与此同时，自古以来，人们就意识到独处与精神专注之间存在联系。

meanwhile.sentenceEn: Meanwhile , in US trials, the self-ordering screens that McDonald's is currently installing at its 1,300 UK restaurants yielded a reported 30% rise in order values.
meanwhile.translationZh: 与此同时，在美国的试点中，麦当劳目前在英国 1,300 家餐厅安装的自助点餐机据报道使订单额增长了 30%。

meanwhile.sentenceEn: Making your own lunch, meanwhile , will cost less.
meanwhile.translationZh: 与此同时，自己做午饭会更省钱。
meanwhile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第15句

meanwhile.sentenceEn: Meanwhile , technology has quashed(使无效), one by one, claims that cognitive tasks require a human brain.
meanwhile.translationZh: 与此同时，技术正逐一推翻那些认为认知任务必须依靠人类大脑才能完成的断言。
meanwhile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

meanwhile.sentenceEn: Meanwhile , countries that manage to run off renewables typically do so thanks to extraordinary hydroelectric capabilities.
meanwhile.translationZh: 与此同时，那些成功实现可再生能源供电的国家，通常都得益于其非凡的水力发电能力。
meanwhile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

mood.sentenceEn: Soon when you log into a restaurant app, it will be able to use your data and purchasing history to recommend dishes to you — factoring in everything from the weather to, if you are ordering at a screen that can read your face, your mood .
mood.translationZh: 不久之后，当你登录餐厅应用时，系统将能利用你的个人数据和购买历史为你推荐菜肴——它会综合考虑从天气状况到你当前心情的所有因素，如果你是在一个具备面部识别功能的屏幕前下单，系统甚至能读懂你的情绪。

mood.sentenceEn: It turns out a pleasant mood can lead to clarity in a person's thinking.
mood.translationZh: 事实证明，好心情能让人思路清晰。
mood.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

mood.sentenceEn: It can also turn down the body's stress response, resulting in an overall happier mood .
mood.translationZh: 它还能降低身体的压力反应，从而带来整体更愉悦的情绪。
mood.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

mood.sentenceEn: If our mood is low, the wisdom to behave differently seems to disappear and we go back to eating more and exercising less.
mood.translationZh: 当我们情绪低落时，改变行为的智慧似乎消失了，我们会回到多吃少动的状态。

mood.sentenceEn: Without a happy mood , it seems that our wisdom to adopt a different behavior vanishes.
mood.translationZh: 如果没有愉悦的心情，我们采取不同行为的智慧似乎就会消失。

manner.sentenceEn: By being snobbish about manners , Proper Bostonians made other people scornful of courtesy, he says.
manner.translationZh: 他说，由于波士顿上流人士对礼仪的势利态度，反而让其他人对礼貌嗤之以鼻。
manner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第10句

manner.sentenceEn: Ralph Whitehead, a professor of journalism at the University of Massachusetts at Amherst, thinks it's because Boston's upper class used manners to make class distinctions.
manner.translationZh: 马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校新闻学教授拉尔夫·怀特黑德认为，这是因为波士顿的上层阶级用礼仪来区分社会阶层。
manner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第9句

manner.sentenceEn: Sarcastic statements are expressed in a cutting manner ; witty remarks are delivered with undisguised and harmless humor.
manner.translationZh: 讽刺性言论往往尖酸刻薄；而诙谐的话语则带着毫不掩饰却又无伤大雅的幽默。
manner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第4句

manner.sentenceEn: Others live incredibly wealthy and luxurious lives and so the wealth is distributed in a very unequal manner .
manner.translationZh: 另一些人则过着极其富有奢华的生活，因此财富分配极为不均。
manner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

manner.sentenceEn: What do we learn about the clever and deceitful characters in a comedy of manners ?
manner.translationZh: 关于风尚喜剧（或译：世态喜剧）中的聪明狡黠角色，我们能了解到什么？

manner.sentenceEn: Refuse their advice in an undisguised manner .
manner.translationZh: 直截了当地拒绝他们的建议。

muscle.sentenceEn: So, if the brain is not a muscle , can it still be exercised?
muscle.translationZh: 那么，如果大脑不是肌肉，它还能被锻炼吗？

muscle.sentenceEn: While it makes for a colorful analogy, comparing the brain to a muscle is inaccurate and misleading.
muscle.translationZh: 尽管将大脑比作肌肉是个生动的比喻，但这种类比并不准确，甚至具有误导性。

muscle.sentenceEn: Although these are colorful analogies, in reality the brain is not a muscle .
muscle.translationZh: 尽管这些比喻很生动形象，但实际上大脑并非肌肉。

muscle.sentenceEn: In addition, although some muscle cells have a lifespan of only a few days, brain cells last a lifetime.
muscle.translationZh: 此外，虽然有些肌肉细胞的寿命只有几天，但脑细胞却能伴随人一生。

muscle.sentenceEn: The brain is different from muscles in that it keeps working even when the body is at rest.
muscle.translationZh: 大脑与肌肉的不同之处在于，即使在身体休息时，大脑也会持续工作。

muscle.sentenceEn: Workers use brains more than muscles .
muscle.translationZh: 员工更多地用脑力而非体力工作。

motivation.sentenceEn: Advocates of the passion principle found it compelling because they believed that following one's passion can provide workers with both the motivation necessary to work hard and a place to find fulfillment.
motivation.translationZh: 激情原则的拥护者认为这一理念极具吸引力，因为他们相信，追随个人激情不仅能为工作者提供努力工作所需的动力，还能为其找到成就感提供途径。
motivation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

motivation.sentenceEn: In the case of office meetings, where some of employees' most valuable resources are their focus, alertness and motivation , this can mean an abrupt halt in productivity as they take time to recover.
motivation.translationZh: 就办公室会议而言，员工最宝贵的资源包括专注力、警觉性和积极性，这种干扰可能意味着生产力突然中断，因为他们需要时间恢复。

motivation.sentenceEn: It can hinder other more positive motivation types, such as completing a task purely because it's fulfilling or enjoyable.
motivation.translationZh: 它会阻碍其他更积极的动机类型，比如纯粹因为某项任务能带来成就感或乐趣而去完成它。
motivation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

motivation.sentenceEn: But thankfully, for those people compelled almost entirely by this specific form of motivation , the news isn't all bad, or bad at all.
motivation.translationZh: 但值得庆幸的是，对于那些几乎完全受这种特定动机驱使的人来说，情况并非全是坏事，甚至可以说一点也不坏。
motivation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

motivation.sentenceEn: This form of motivation is widely regarded as a negative type of motivation .
motivation.translationZh: 这种动机形式被广泛认为是一种消极的动机类型。
motivation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

motivation.sentenceEn: It may result in negative motivation .
motivation.translationZh: 这可能会导致消极的动机。

mobile.sentenceEn: This economy rests on a technological revolution of mobile phones and social media that makes it possible for corporations to target our attention with their content at every moment.
mobile.translationZh: 这种经济模式建立在手机和社交媒体的技术革命之上，这使得公司能够在每一刻都利用其内容来锁定我们的注意力。
mobile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

mobile.sentenceEn: While many young children are now growing up with digital media exposure through mobile devices like tablets and phones, television remains a dominant screen activity, accounting for 72% of all screen time.
mobile.translationZh: 尽管现在许多幼儿通过平板电脑和手机等移动设备接触数字媒体长大，但电视仍是主要的屏幕活动，占所有屏幕时间的72%。
mobile.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

mobile.sentenceEn: There are now many computer, online, and mobile device applications that claim to be able to "train your brain," and they typically tap into a variety of cognitive abilities.
mobile.translationZh: 现在有许多电脑、在线和移动设备应用程序声称能够“训练你的大脑”，它们通常会开发各种认知能力。

mobile.sentenceEn: The telegraph, the telephone, and radio were the obvious predecessors of the Internet, iPods, and mobile phones.
mobile.translationZh: 电报、电话和无线电显然是互联网、iPod和移动电话的前身。

mobile.sentenceEn: What happens with the prevalent use of mobile phones or social media?
mobile.translationZh: 随着手机或社交媒体的普及使用，会发生什么情况？

mobile.sentenceEn: Businesses profit from selling mobile phones and revolutionizing social media.
mobile.translationZh: 企业通过销售手机和革新社交媒体来获取利润。

marathon.sentenceEn: Given the opportunity, I will sleep for marathon stretches, and can doze through the most extreme situations.
marathon.translationZh: 只要有机会，我就能睡上很长时间，而且就算在最极端的情况下也能打盹。
marathon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

marathon.sentenceEn: Registration for the event costs 36,000 euros, which covers international charter flights to each of the seven marathon locations: Union Glacier (Antarctica), Punta Arenas, Chile (South America), Miami (North America), Madrid (Europe), Marrakesh, Morocco (Africa), Dubai (Asia) and Sydney (Australia).
marathon.translationZh: 该赛事的报名费为36,000欧元，包含飞往七个马拉松举办地的国际包机费用：联合冰川（南极洲）、智利蓬塔阿雷纳斯（南美洲）、迈阿密（北美洲）、马德里（欧洲）、摩洛哥马拉喀什（非洲）、迪拜（亚洲）以及悉尼（澳大利亚）。

marathon.sentenceEn: An elite ultra-runner, Wardian has his sights on breaking the event's record average marathon time of 3:32:25 set last January by U.S. Marine Corps captain Daniel Cartica.
marathon.translationZh: 作为一名精英超级马拉松选手，沃迪安的目标是打破该项赛事的平均马拉松时间纪录——3小时32分25秒，该纪录由美国海军陆战队上尉丹尼尔·卡蒂卡于去年1月创下。

marathon.sentenceEn: He will line up Monday in Antarctica(南极) for the first leg of the World Marathon Challenge—joining 32 other adventure seekers on an unusual journey where participants travel through different time zones and climates to run seven marathons on seven continents in seven days.
marathon.translationZh: 周一，他将在南极站到起跑线前，参加世界马拉松挑战赛的第一站比赛——与其他32名探险爱好者一同踏上这段非凡旅程。参赛者将穿越不同时区和气候带，在七天内于七大洲完成七场马拉松。

marathon.sentenceEn: Wardian is going to join over thirty other runners in a week-long marathon series.
marathon.translationZh: 沃迪安将与其他三十多名跑者一起参加为期一周的马拉松系列赛。

marathon.sentenceEn: She boasted of her marathon race.
marathon.translationZh: 她吹嘘自己参加了马拉松比赛。

mix.sentenceEn: The survey found that 15% of Americans loved to cook, 50% said they hated to cook and 35% reported mixed feelings.
mix.translationZh: 调查发现，15% 的美国人热爱烹饪，50% 的人表示讨厌烹饪，剩下 35% 的人则表示对此感觉一般。
mix.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

mix.sentenceEn: Many scientists believe that earth has now entered the sixth mass extinction, with humans creating a toxic mix of habitat loss, pollution and climate change, which has already led to the loss of at least 77 species of mammals and 140 types of birds since 1500.
mix.translationZh: 许多科学家认为地球现已进入第六次大规模灭绝时期，人类造成的栖息地丧失、污染和气候变化等不利因素相互交织，自1500年以来已导致至少77种哺乳动物和140种鸟类灭绝。
mix.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

mix.sentenceEn: Most teachers today, almost three out of four according to a survey by the Ed Week Research Centre in 2019, use a mix called "balanced literacy".
mix.translationZh: 如今，大多数教师——根据《教育周刊》研究中心2019年的一项调查，比例接近四分之三——采用一种名为“平衡读写法”的混合教学模式。
mix.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

mix.sentenceEn: And Beth Ann Telford, a 47-year-old federal government worker from Fairfax and the only American female in this year's mix , is using the event as a platform to raise money for cancer research.
mix.translationZh: 而47岁的贝丝·安·特尔福德来自费尔法克斯，是一名联邦政府工作人员，也是今年参赛选手中唯一的美国女性，她正利用这项赛事作为平台为癌症研究筹集资金。

mix.sentenceEn: For what purpose is stale bread mixed into gazpacho?
mix.translationZh: 陈面包被混入西班牙冻汤中的目的是什么？

mix.sentenceEn: Their children began to mix with each other.
mix.translationZh: 他们的后代开始相互通婚

mobility.sentenceEn: And yet, young Americans today are struggling to earn more than their parents did at the same age, and upward mobility in the US actually compares unfavourably to that of other industrialised nations.
mobility.translationZh: 然而，如今的美国年轻人正艰难地想要比父母在同年龄段时挣得更多，而美国的向上流动性实际上比其他工业化国家要差。
mobility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

mobility.sentenceEn: Kim concludes that "rags-to-riches entertainment media are an important cultural force that promotes and perpetuates beliefs in upward mobility ".
mobility.translationZh: 金得出结论：“白手起家类娱乐媒体是一种重要的文化力量，它宣扬并 perpetuates 人们对向上流动的信念。”
mobility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

mobility.sentenceEn: Rags-to-riches stories are ubiquitous(无处不在的) on TV—but does watching these programmes actually convince people that economic mobility is easily attainable?
mobility.translationZh: 从白手起家到腰缠万贯的故事在电视上随处可见——但观看这些节目真的会让人们相信经济阶层的流动是轻而易举就能实现的吗？
mobility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

mobility.sentenceEn: The value of a college degree is diminishing, and our upward mobility is declining.
mobility.translationZh: 大学学位的价值正在下降，我们的向上流动性也在减弱。
mobility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

mobility.sentenceEn: What is stated about people who believe in upward mobility ?
mobility.translationZh: 关于相信向上流动的人们，文中是如何描述的？

mobility.sentenceEn: They find it difficult to achieve upward mobility .
mobility.translationZh: 他们发现很难实现向上流动。

multiple.sentenceEn: From tiny public libraries to huge city institutions with multiple branches, libraries across the United States are building community and supporting local culture in exciting ways.
multiple.translationZh: 从规模小巧的公共图书馆到拥有多个分馆的大型城市机构，美国各地的图书馆正以令人振奋的方式建设社区并支持当地文化。

multiple.sentenceEn: In fact, multiple studies have found that electronic books support story comprehension and vocabulary gains beyond what is provided by printed books.
multiple.translationZh: 事实上，多项研究发现，电子书在促进故事理解和词汇积累方面的效果，甚至超过了纸质书籍。
multiple.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

multiple.sentenceEn: One reason linguists agree there is no one true standard is that, through the years, there have been multiple supposed standards, depending on time and place.
multiple.translationZh: 语言学家们一致认为不存在唯一的标准，原因之一在于，受时代和地域影响，历史上曾出现过多种所谓的标准。
multiple.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

multiple.sentenceEn: It's one of multiple chambers where scientists are studying the impact of higher temperatures and carbon dioxide levels on the nutritional make-up of alternative crops.
multiple.translationZh: 这是多个试验舱之一，科学家们正在这里研究高温和二氧化碳浓度升高对替代作物营养成分的影响。

multiple.sentenceEn: If contributing factors leading to housing becoming less than affordable are not resolved over multiple generations, a small elite will control a vast share of the country's total wealth.
multiple.translationZh: 如果导致住房难以负担的促成因素在几代人的时间里得不到解决，一小部分精英阶层将控制国家总财富的绝大部分。

multiple.sentenceEn: It examined data collected from multiple countries.
multiple.translationZh: 它研究了从多个国家收集的数据。

musician.sentenceEn: It can serve as a source of inspiration, and as an ideal jumping-off point should a musician be hit with writer's block(文思枯竭).
musician.translationZh: 它可以作为灵感来源，当音乐家遭遇文思枯竭时，还能成为理想的创作起点。
musician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

musician.sentenceEn: Contrary to seeing AI as a tool, some musicians consider it to be hugely detrimental to the music scene.
musician.translationZh: 与将人工智能视为工具的观点相反，一些音乐家认为它对音乐界极为不利。
musician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

musician.sentenceEn: Those who have produced their own music, or even fans of authentic, artistic music, will also argue that a computer could never emulate the work (and human touch) of a true musician .
musician.translationZh: 那些自己创作音乐的人，甚至是真正艺术音乐的爱好者，也会认为计算机永远无法模仿真正音乐家的作品（以及其中的人文温度）。
musician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

musician.sentenceEn: Since American idol star Taryn Southern started composing music with AI in 2017, musicians all over the world have begun wondering about the implications of AI and modern technology where music production is concerned.
musician.translationZh: 自从《美国偶像》明星塔琳·萨瑟恩2017年开始使用人工智能创作音乐以来，世界各地的音乐家们便开始思考人工智能和现代技术在音乐制作方面的影响。
musician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

musician.sentenceEn: Why are some musicians opposed to the use of AI in creating music?
musician.translationZh: 为什么有些音乐家反对在音乐创作中使用人工智能？

musician.sentenceEn: It will be gradually accepted by old-school musicians .
musician.translationZh: 老牌音乐家们也会逐渐接受它。

mere.sentenceEn: According to a study that came out in March, elite sleepers have rare genetic changes, which means they can sleep fewer hours than mere mortals, without any risk of cognitive decline.
mere.translationZh: 根据3月份发表的一项研究，精英睡眠者拥有罕见的基因变异，这意味着他们可以比普通人睡眠时间更少，且不会有认知能力下降的风险。
mere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

mere.sentenceEn: Instead of experiencing a benefaction(善行) as a good turn, people sometimes regard it as a mere payment of what they are owed, for which no one deserves any moral credit.
mere.translationZh: 人们有时不把善行视为一种善举，而是将其看作对方仅仅在偿还所欠自己的东西，因此认为这种行为不值得任何道德上的赞扬。

mere.sentenceEn: In its long history, it has never been expanded, remaining as a single loop line with a mere 15 stations.
mere.translationZh: 在其悠久的历史中，地铁从未进行过扩建，始终保持着单环线的格局，仅有15个车站。
mere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

mere.sentenceEn: The problem is that the mere presence of jargon sends a discouraging message to readers.
mere.translationZh: 问题在于，专业术语的存在本身就向读者传递了令人沮丧的信号。
mere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

mere.sentenceEn: His maiden rocket voyage lasted a mere 3 seconds.
mere.translationZh: 他的首次火箭飞行仅持续了3秒钟。
mere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

mere.sentenceEn: Take the experience as a mere game.
mere.translationZh: 把这段经历当作一场游戏就好。

mom.sentenceEn: New moms connect at baby story-times; elderly people, often facing difficult life transitions, attend events and find that they make new friends; teenagers meet up in libraries' teen spaces after school; and readers discuss current events in the periodicals room.
mom.translationZh: 新手妈妈们通过婴儿故事会相互结识；老年人往往面临艰难的人生转折，他们参加活动并发现自己交到了新朋友；青少年放学后在图书馆的青少年专区相聚；读者们则在期刊阅览室讨论时事。

mom.sentenceEn: And those adult children may spend more generously when it comes to celebrating the moms they no longer live with.
mom.translationZh: 而这些成年子女在庆祝与自己分开居住的母亲时，可能会花费得更加慷慨。
mom.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

mom.sentenceEn: Moms today tend to be older than in the past.
mom.translationZh: 如今的妈妈们往往比过去年龄更大。
mom.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

mom.sentenceEn: Not only are moms making up less of the population, but their characteristics are changing too, and in a way that might be linked to their proportional decline.
mom.translationZh: 母亲在人口中的占比不仅在下降，她们的特征也在发生变化，而这种变化可能与其占比下降有关。
mom.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

mom.sentenceEn: As the American population grows, so does the number of American moms .
mom.translationZh: 随着美国人口的增长，美国妈妈的数量也在增加。
mom.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

mom.sentenceEn: American moms have been increasingly inclined to live alone.
mom.translationZh: 美国妈妈们越来越倾向于独居。

momentum.sentenceEn: There is a growing global momentum around forgotten foods, says Danielle Nierenberg, president of Food Tank, a US-based think tank.
momentum.translationZh: 总部位于美国的智库“粮食罐”(Food Tank)总裁丹妮尔·尼伦伯格(Danielle Nierenberg)表示，全球对被遗忘食物的关注正日益增强。

momentum.sentenceEn: It is a movement building steady momentum : a call to make research data, software code and experimental methods publicly available and transparent.
momentum.translationZh: 这是一场势头不断增强的运动：呼吁将研究数据、软件代码和实验方法公开透明化。

momentum.sentenceEn: The fame passed down the years, gaining momentum from mere exposure as it did so.
momentum.translationZh: 这种声誉年复一年地传承下来，在此过程中，仅仅通过不断曝光就获得了越来越强的影响力。

momentum.sentenceEn: Unfortunately for them (and often the taxpayers), our energy systems are a bit like an aircraft carrier: they are unbelievably expensive, they are built to last for a very long time, they have a huge amount of inertia (meaning it takes a lot of energy to set them moving), and they have a lot of momentum once they are set in motion.
momentum.translationZh: 对他们（通常也对纳税人）来说不幸的是，我们的能源系统有点像航空母舰：造价高得惊人，设计使用寿命极长，惯性巨大（意味着需要耗费大量能源才能启动），而且一旦运行起来就会产生强大的动量。

momentum.sentenceEn: One kind of momentum is technological momentum .
momentum.translationZh: 其中一种势头是技术势头。

momentum.sentenceEn: Not only moving objects and people but all systems have momentum .
momentum.translationZh: 不仅移动物体和人具有动量，所有系统也都具有动量。

mutual.sentenceEn: Dr. Curry hopes that this research helps to promote mutual understanding between people of different cultures and appreciation of what we have in common and how and why we differ.
mutual.translationZh: 柯里博士希望这项研究能够促进不同文化背景人们之间的相互理解，增进对我们共同之处以及差异所在及其原因的认识。
mutual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

mutual.sentenceEn: Broadly speaking, a community in which people feel grateful to one another is likely to be a more pleasant place to live than one characterized by mutual suspicion and resentment.
mutual.translationZh: 广义而言，一个人们彼此心怀感激的社区，很可能比一个充满相互猜疑与怨恨的社区更适宜居住。

mutual.sentenceEn: As a result, they regard these individuals with greater trust and mutual understanding, which motivates them to seek further opportunities for collaboration.
mutual.translationZh: 因此，他们会给予这些人更多的信任和相互理解，这促使他们寻求更多的合作机会。
mutual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

mutual.sentenceEn: "We need to find a way to put ourselves at the global table and to treat each other with mutual respect. And learning languages allows us to do that because language is not part of culture, language is culture."
mutual.translationZh: 我们需要找到一种方式参与到全球对话中，并以相互尊重的态度对待彼此。而学习语言能让我们做到这一点，因为语言不是文化的一部分，语言本身就是文化。

mutual.sentenceEn: On the topic of trade, productive debates might be possible, in contrast to the familiar mutual condemnation in discussing other issues.
mutual.translationZh: 在贸易议题上，或许有可能进行富有成效的辩论，这与在讨论其他问题时常见的相互指责形成了对比。

mutual.sentenceEn: Struggles for survival do not exclude mutual support.
mutual.translationZh: 生存竞争并不排斥相互支持。

migrate.sentenceEn: This calls into question the idea that modern humans migrated out of Africa only 60,000 years ago.
migrate.translationZh: 这对现代人类仅在6万年前迁出非洲的观点提出了质疑。
migrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

migrate.sentenceEn: It could be that our raw intelligence gave us an unprecedented ability to think outside the box, innovating solutions to thorny problems as people migrated across the globe.
migrate.translationZh: 这可能是因为我们原始的智力赋予了我们前所未有的跳出思维定势的能力，在人类向全球迁移的过程中不断创新，解决棘手难题。
migrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

migrate.sentenceEn: With rewilding now firmly on the environmental policy agenda, the hope is that in future, spiders will be enabled to migrate by themselves, adapting to climate change by moving along wildlife corridors.
migrate.translationZh: 随着生态恢复现已被正式提上环境政策议程，人们希望未来蜘蛛将能够自行迁徙，通过野生动物走廊移动来适应气候变化。
migrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

migrate.sentenceEn: But conservationists are most concerned about those varieties that are threatened due to habitat loss and fragmentation, which makes it impossible for them to migrate .
migrate.translationZh: 但自然资源保护主义者最为担忧的是那些因栖息地丧失和碎片化而受到威胁的蜘蛛种类，这使得它们无法迁徙。
migrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

migrate.sentenceEn: What happened after humans migrated from Africa to other parts of the world?
migrate.translationZh: 人类从非洲迁移到世界其他地区后发生了什么？

migrate.sentenceEn: More and more spider species are found losing their ability to migrate .
migrate.translationZh: 越来越多的蜘蛛物种正逐渐丧失迁徙能力。

mining.sentenceEn: Higgins subsequently hired a mining engineer, Captain Anthony Lucas.
mining.translationZh: 希金斯随后聘请了一位采矿工程师——安东尼·卢卡斯上尉。
mining.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

mining.sentenceEn: The ongoing push by the mining corporations to be more productive and more efficient is another powerful driver in embracing automation technology.
mining.translationZh: 矿业公司持续追求更高生产力和效率的努力，是其采用自动化技术的另一强大驱动力。
mining.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第7句

mining.sentenceEn: The mining companies here produce almost 300 million tons of iron ore a year.
mining.translationZh: 这里的矿业公司每年生产近3亿吨铁矿石。
mining.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

mining.sentenceEn: Advocates argue these automated vehicles will change mining forever.
mining.translationZh: 支持者认为，这些自动化车辆将彻底改变采矿行业。
mining.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

mining.sentenceEn: What is the impact of the digitization of the mining industry?
mining.translationZh: 采矿业数字化的影响是什么？

mining.sentenceEn: It calls for the retraining of unskilled mining workers.
mining.translationZh: 这需要对非技术采矿工人进行再培训。

mission.sentenceEn: Loftis's mission is to know where the water goes before it goes there.
mission.translationZh: 洛夫蒂斯的目标是在洪水泛滥之前就预测出水将流向何处。
mission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

mission.sentenceEn: The Sunken Military Craft Act of 2004, a US federal act, protects any vessel that was on a military mission , allowing the originating country to claim their ship even centuries later.
mission.translationZh: 2004年《沉没军事舰艇法案》是一项美国联邦法案，它保护所有执行过军事任务的舰艇，允许其原产国即使在数百年后仍可对其船只提出所有权主张。

mission.sentenceEn: We have built endowments from donations by alumni(校友) and parents who understand and appreciate our mission to provide access and opportunity, and a significant portion of the returns from these endowments is used to fund financial aid.
mission.translationZh: 我们通过校友和家长的捐赠建立了捐赠基金，他们理解并认同我们提供教育机会的使命。这些捐赠基金产生的收益中有很大一部分用于资助助学金。
mission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

mission.sentenceEn: He was able to do this because of a combination of factors—most important, timing and opportunity—but the single-mindedness and determination with which he carried out his self-imposed mission was fundamentally character-based; millions of Marconi's contemporaries had the same class, gender, race, and colonial privilege as he, but only a handful did anything with it.
mission.translationZh: 他之所以能做到这一点，是多种因素共同作用的结果——其中最重要的是时机和机遇——但他执行自我设定使命时所展现的专注与决心，本质上源于他的性格特质。与马可尼同时代的数百万人拥有与他相同的阶级、性别、种族和殖民特权，但只有极少数人能善用这些优势。

mission.sentenceEn: What does the passage say is Derek Loftis's mission ?
mission.translationZh: 文章称德里克·洛夫蒂斯的使命是什么？

mission.sentenceEn: A weather expert invited him to go there for his mission .
mission.translationZh: 一位气象专家建议他前往那里开展研究工作。

mature.sentenceEn: So, we agree that Rachel appeared inexperienced and less mature than Peter, even though both candidates are the same age and have practically no work experience.
mature.translationZh: 那么，我们都认为雷切尔显得不如彼得有经验，也不够成熟，尽管两位候选人年龄相同，而且实际上都没有工作经验。
mature.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

mature.sentenceEn: I think he definitely looked more mature than Rachel.
mature.translationZh: 我觉得他看起来确实比瑞秋成熟得多。
mature.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

mature.sentenceEn: Little deliberate attention is given to how students mature as individuals and social beings.
mature.translationZh: 很少有人刻意关注学生如何作为个体和社会成员成长成熟。

mature.sentenceEn: Antagonism toward tourists typically develops in mature , heavily visited destinations.
mature.translationZh: 对游客的敌意通常在发展成熟、游客密集的目的地形成。
mature.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

mature.sentenceEn: The electronic industry is maturing even though no wonder products hit the market.
mature.translationZh: 尽管市场上没有出现轰动一时的产品，但电子行业正在走向成熟。

mature.sentenceEn: Help them take up these sports when they are more mature .
mature.translationZh: 等他们更成熟一些，再帮助他们从事这些运动。

minimize.sentenceEn: Recommendation engines, which are increasingly prevalent intermediaries in people's consumption of culture, may serve to constrain choice and minimize luck.
minimize.translationZh: 推荐引擎作为人们文化消费中日益普及的中介，可能会限制选择并减少偶然性。
minimize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

minimize.sentenceEn: Along the route, armed guards wandered the large sheets of floating ice to minimize the risk of polar bear attacks.
minimize.translationZh: 沿途，武装警卫在巨大的浮冰上巡逻，以最大限度降低北极熊袭击的风险。

minimize.sentenceEn: If the latter is the case, increasing face-to-face time with trusted friends, and minimizing time scrolling online, will prove to be a reminder that your social network is much more rewarding than any "like," "follow" or "share" can be.
minimize.translationZh: 如果是后者，那么增加与可信赖朋友的面对面交流时间，减少在线浏览时间，将会提醒你：真实的社交网络比任何“点赞”、“关注”或“分享”都更有价值。
minimize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

minimize.sentenceEn: At the same time, surveys on consumers in the U.S. and the U.K. show that they also care about minimizing energy use and reducing waste.
minimize.translationZh: 与此同时，针对美国和英国消费者的调查显示，他们同样关注减少能源消耗和降低浪费。

minimize.sentenceEn: Which of the following is helpful for minimizing outside distractions during communication?
minimize.translationZh: 以下哪项有助于在交流过程中减少外界干扰？

minimize.sentenceEn: What steps are taken to minimize their detrimental impact.
minimize.translationZh: 采取了哪些措施来减少其不利影响。

monolingual.sentenceEn: For example, the monolinguals reported, on average, a year and a half more schooling than their bilingual counterparts, so the effect was clearly not due to formal education.
monolingual.translationZh: 例如，样本中的单语者平均比双语者多接受一年半的学校教育，因此这种效应显然不是由正规教育导致的。

monolingual.sentenceEn: A separate study, conducted in India, found strikingly similar results: bilingual patients developed symptoms of dementia 4.5 years later than monolinguals , even after other potential factors, such as gender and occupation, were controlled for.
monolingual.translationZh: 在印度进行的另一项研究发现了惊人相似的结果：双语患者的痴呆症状比单语患者晚出现4.5年，即便在控制了性别和职业等其他潜在因素后亦是如此。

monolingual.sentenceEn: Bilingual individuals have been shown to have smaller vocabularies and to take longer in retrieving words from memory when compared to monolinguals .
monolingual.translationZh: 有研究显示，与单语者相比，双语者的词汇量更小，从记忆中提取词汇所需的时间也更长。

monolingual.sentenceEn: If the benefits of being bilingual spill over to other aspects of cognition, then we would expect to see a lower incidence of Alzheimer's disease in bilinguals than in monolinguals , or at least a later onset of Alzheimer's for bilinguals.
monolingual.translationZh: 如果双语能力带来的益处能延伸到认知的其他方面，那么我们有理由预期双语者的阿尔茨海默氏病发病率会低于单语者，或者至少双语者的阿尔茨海默氏病发病年龄会晚于单语者。

monolingual.sentenceEn: In fact, bilingual individuals outperform their monolingual counterparts on a variety of cognitive tasks, such as following complex instructions, and switching to new instructions.
monolingual.translationZh: 事实上，在各种认知任务中，双语者的表现都优于单语者，例如遵循复杂指令和切换到新指令等任务。

monolingual.sentenceEn: It is claimed that more monolinguals suffer from Alzheimer's disease than bilinguals.
monolingual.translationZh: 据称，患阿尔茨海默氏病的单语者多于双语者。

maintenance.translationZh: 我在阿尔法维修公司工作。
maintenance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

maintenance.sentenceEn: In New York City, for example, coins collected from fountains in public parks often go towards the fountains' maintenance itself, though entrepreneurs who don't mind getting their hands wet often get to it first.
maintenance.translationZh: 例如在纽约市，从公园喷泉中收集的硬币通常用于喷泉本身的维护，但那些不怕湿手的"淘金者"往往会抢先一步把硬币拿走。
maintenance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

maintenance.sentenceEn: The fountain in New York City's Bryant Park is owned and operated by a not-for-profit corporation, which puts the cash collected by cleaners towards the fountain's own maintenance .
maintenance.translationZh: 纽约市布莱恩特公园的喷泉由一家非营利性公司拥有和运营，该公司将清洁工收集的现金用于喷泉自身的维护。
maintenance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

maintenance.sentenceEn: Well, the coins collected can go to all sorts of different places—from fountain maintenance to charity or public service.
maintenance.translationZh: 其实，收集到的硬币有各种各样的去向——从喷泉维护到慈善事业或公共服务都有可能。
maintenance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

maintenance.sentenceEn: There is no reason why visitors to the UK, or domestic tourists on holiday in hotspots such as Cornwall, should be exempt from taxation-particularly when vital local services including waste collection, park maintenance and arts and culture spending are under unprecedented strain.
maintenance.translationZh: 没有理由免除前往英国的游客或在康沃尔等热门景点度假的国内游客的税项——尤其是当垃圾收集、公园维护以及艺术文化支出等重要地方服务正面临前所未有的压力时。
maintenance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

maintenance.sentenceEn: They are mostly used for the fountains' maintenance .
maintenance.translationZh: 这些硬币大多用于喷泉的维护。

minister.sentenceEn: If ministers want to make education pay for young people, they need to look beyond the higher education sector, towards the wider world.
minister.translationZh: 如果大臣们希望教育能让年轻人获得回报，他们就需要把目光投向高等教育领域之外，看向更广阔的世界。
minister.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

minister.sentenceEn: Ministers , according to Onward, should "crack down on courses that offer extremely limited value for money to students ten years after graduation", restricting the ability of such courses to recruit new students, if the average graduate earns below the student loans payment threshold.
minister.translationZh: 前进智库认为，部长们应该“严厉打击那些在毕业生离校十年后仍无法为其带来足够经济回报的课程”，如果某课程毕业生的平均收入低于学生贷款还款门槛，就应限制该类课程的招生名额。
minister.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

minister.sentenceEn: The culture minister , Franck Riester, said religious relics saved from the cathedral were being securely held at the Hotel de Ville, and works of art that sustained smoke damage were being taken to the Louvre, the world's largest art museum, where they would be dried out, repaired and stored.
minister.translationZh: 文化部长弗兰克·里斯特表示，从大教堂中抢救出来的宗教圣物正被妥善保管在巴黎市政厅，而遭受烟熏损坏的艺术品则被送往世界最大的艺术博物馆卢浮宫，在那里进行干燥、修复和保存。

minister.sentenceEn: After the blaze was declared completely extinguished, 15 hours after it started, the junior interior minister , Laurent Nunez, said the structure had been saved but remained vulnerable.
minister.translationZh: 在大火开始15小时后被宣布完全扑灭后，法国内政部副部长洛朗·努涅斯表示，建筑主体已被挽救，但仍处于脆弱状态。

minister.sentenceEn: What does Onward's report propose ministers should do?
minister.translationZh: Onward的报告建议部长们应该做什么？

minister.sentenceEn: He served as a church minister for many years.

magstripe.sentenceEn: While American credit cards use the 40-year-old magstripe technology to process transactions, much of the rest of the world uses smarter cards with a technology called EMV (short for Europay, MasterCard, Visa) that employs a chip embedded in the card plus a customer PIN (personal identification number) to authenticate(验证) every transaction on the spot.
magstripe.translationZh: 美国的信用卡仍在使用已有40年历史的磁条技术来处理交易，而世界上大多数国家和地区已在使用更先进的智能卡，这种卡片采用名为EMV（即Europay、MasterCard、Visa三家公司的缩写，中文常称'芯片卡'）的技术，卡内嵌入芯片并结合客户个人识别码（PIN），可当场验证每笔交易。

magstripe.sentenceEn: Credit and debit cards, though, are going to be with us for the foreseeable future, and so are hackers, if we stick with magstripe technology.
magstripe.translationZh: 然而，如果我们继续使用磁条技术，信用卡和借记卡在可预见的未来仍将与我们相伴，黑客亦是如此。

magstripe.sentenceEn: It's actually a hybrid(混合体) that will still have a magstripe , since most U.S. merchants don't have EMV terminals.
magstripe.translationZh: 实际上这是一种混合卡，仍然保留着磁条，因为大多数美国商家还没有配备EMV终端机。

magstripe.sentenceEn: Some big banks, like Wells Fargo, are now offering to convert your magstripe card to a chip-and-PIN model.
magstripe.translationZh: 一些大型银行，如富国银行，现在开始提供磁条卡转芯片密码卡的服务。

magstripe.sentenceEn: Each magstripe has three tracks of information, explains payments security expert Jeremy Gumbley, the chief technology officer of Credit Call, an electronic-payments company.
magstripe.translationZh: 电子支付公司Credit Call的首席技术官、支付安全专家杰里米·冈布利解释说，每条磁条都包含三个信息轨道。

magstripe.sentenceEn: The use of magstripe cards by American retailers leaves consumers exposed to the risks of losing account information.
magstripe.translationZh: 美国零售商对磁条卡的使用使消费者面临账户信息丢失的风险。

maker.sentenceEn: When psychologist Jessica Pryor lived near an internationally renowned university, she once saw a student walking into a library holding a sleeping bag and a coffee maker .
maker.translationZh: 心理学家杰西卡·普赖尔曾住在一所国际知名大学附近，有一次她看到一名学生抱着睡袋和咖啡机走进图书馆。

maker.sentenceEn: Many public health policy makers believe that the resolution of age-associated disease will tell us something fundamental about the ageing process, but say some top scientists, that's completely erroneous.
maker.translationZh: 许多公共卫生政策制定者认为，解决与年龄相关的疾病将为我们揭示衰老过程的某些基本规律，但一些顶尖科学家表示，这种观点完全错误。
maker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

maker.sentenceEn: A product request was sent to eight different glass makers .
maker.translationZh: 公司向八家不同的玻璃制造商发出了产品需求。
maker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

maker.sentenceEn: In the long run, excuse makers fail to live up to their true potential and lose the status they care so much about.
maker.translationZh: 从长远来看，找借口的人无法发挥自己真正的潜力，并且会失去他们如此在乎的地位。
maker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

maker.sentenceEn: In fact, the people most likely to become chronic excuse makers are those obsessed with success.
maker.translationZh: 事实上，最容易成为长期找借口的人，是那些痴迷于成功的人。
maker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

maker.sentenceEn: What do many public health policy makers believe?
maker.translationZh: 许多公共卫生政策制定者相信什么？

manufacture.sentenceEn: However, when they looked at transportation's carbon footprint, they ignored impacts on the climate from manufacturing vehicle materials and parts, assembling vehicles and maintaining roads, bridges and airports.
manufacture.translationZh: 然而，在考察交通运输的碳足迹时，他们忽略了制造车辆材料和零部件、组装车辆以及维护道路、桥梁和机场对气候的影响。

manufacture.sentenceEn: There is scarcely a single commodity in any American household that isn't dependent for its manufacture and sale, through one supply chain or another, on scores of different people spread out across the entire globe.
manufacture.translationZh: 美国家庭中的任何一种商品，其生产和销售几乎都要通过这样或那样的供应链，依赖遍布全球的众多不同人员。

manufacture.sentenceEn: Manufacturing flat screens adds greenhouse gases to the atmosphere.
manufacture.translationZh: 平板屏幕的制造过程会向大气中排放温室气体。
manufacture.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

manufacture.sentenceEn: The do-it-yourself furniture and houseware company first developed a compelling set of capabilities to design, manufacture and ship furniture at low cost and sell it in a novel way in Sweden.
manufacture.translationZh: 这家自助组装家具和家居用品公司首先在瑞典开发出了一套令人瞩目的核心能力：以低成本设计、制造和运输家具，并以新颖的方式进行销售。
manufacture.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

manufacture.sentenceEn: Few commodities in American homes are not reliant on people abroad in the process of manufacture and sale.
manufacture.translationZh: 美国家庭中，很少有商品在生产和销售过程中不依赖国外人员。

manufacture.sentenceEn: They are hooked on manufacturing convenience foods.
manufacture.translationZh: 这些公司沉迷于生产方便食品。

meaningful.sentenceEn: Mindfulness has been shown to have a number of meaningful health benefits — it can help reduce anxiety and promote healing in those suffering from chronic illness.
meaningful.translationZh: 研究表明，正念具有诸多显著的健康益处——它能帮助缓解焦虑，并促进慢性病患者的康复。
meaningful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

meaningful.sentenceEn: In the final study, French participants indicated the extent to which they felt they led a purposeful and meaningful life and how much they considered themselves a happy person.
meaningful.translationZh: 在最后一项研究中，法国参与者指出了他们认为自己过着有目标和有意义生活的程度，以及他们认为自己是一个快乐的人的程度。
meaningful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第13句

meaningful.sentenceEn: Usually, when a person smells something that's connected to a meaningful event in their past, they'll first have an emotional response to the sensation and then a memory might follow.
meaningful.translationZh: 通常，当一个人闻到与过去某个有意义事件相关的气味时，他们会首先对这种感觉产生情绪反应，随后可能会唤起相关记忆。
meaningful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

meaningful.sentenceEn: People are endlessly fascinated by themselves and their friends, and the subtle differences in how people think about the world are really meaningful to them.
meaningful.translationZh: 人们总是对自己和朋友充满好奇，而人们思考世界方式上的细微差异对他们而言确实意义非凡。
meaningful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

meaningful.sentenceEn: While finding solutions for loneliness is highly personal, research suggests the best interventions are those that involve meaningful social contact at least once a week.
meaningful.translationZh: 虽然解决孤独问题的方法高度个性化，但研究表明，最佳干预措施是每周至少进行一次有意义的社交接触。
meaningful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

meaningful.sentenceEn: It provided meaningful clues to solving the problem.
meaningful.translationZh: 这为解决该问题提供了有意义的线索。

military.sentenceEn: The old military saying "You never rise to the occasion, you only sink to the level of training" also applies to behavior change.
military.translationZh: 古老的军事谚语"你永远无法超越平时的训练水平，只能发挥训练时的水准"同样适用于行为改变。

military.sentenceEn: The Sunken Military Craft Act of 2004, a US federal act, protects any vessel that was on a military mission, allowing the originating country to claim their ship even centuries later.
military.translationZh: 2004年《沉没军事舰艇法案》是一项美国联邦法案，它保护所有执行过军事任务的舰艇，允许其原产国即使在数百年后仍可对其船只提出所有权主张。

military.sentenceEn: In spite of his many successes, Goddard was never able to interest the US military in rocket-propelled weapons.
military.translationZh: 尽管取得了诸多成就，戈达德始终未能引起美国军方对火箭推进武器的兴趣。
military.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

military.sentenceEn: With me today is Heidi Brown, a historian who has written five critically acclaimed books about military history.
military.translationZh: 今天来到我们节目现场的是海蒂·布朗，她是一位历史学家，撰写了五部广受好评的军事历史著作。
military.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

military.sentenceEn: More than a century has passed since explorers raced to plant their flags at the bottom of the world, and for decades to come this continent is supposed to be protected as a scientific preserve, shielded from intrusions like military activities and mining.
military.translationZh: 一个多世纪前，探险家们竞相在地球最南端插上自己国家的旗帜，而在接下来的几十年里，这片大陆本应作为科学保护区受到保护，免受军事活动和采矿等行为的侵扰。

military.sentenceEn: He boosted the military strength of the United States.
military.translationZh: 他增强了美国的军事实力。

minority.sentenceEn: Archives preserve historic artifacts, oral histories, digital history projects, and scholarly writings relevant to the community, including minority groups.
minority.translationZh: 档案馆保存与社区相关的历史文物、口述历史、数字历史项目和学术著作，包括少数群体的相关资料。

minority.sentenceEn: Today, the vast majority of Americans buy clothing; only a tiny minority still sew, and they do it mainly as a hobby.
minority.translationZh: 现如今，绝大多数美国人都购买现成服装；只有极少数人仍旧自己缝纫，且主要将其作为一种个人爱好。
minority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第9句

minority.sentenceEn: A vocal minority is even calling on officials to punish those who are benefitting from the economic and housing boom.
minority.translationZh: 一部分直言不讳的少数群体甚至呼吁官员惩罚那些从经济和住房繁荣中获益的人。

minority.sentenceEn: While those types certainly exist, they are a minority .
minority.translationZh: 虽然这类管理者确实存在，但他们只是少数。
minority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

minority.sentenceEn: Minority cultures were often featured in stereotypical or tokenistic ways, for example, by portraying Asian culture with chopsticks and traditional dress.
minority.translationZh: 少数族裔文化往往以刻板或象征性的方式呈现，例如，通过筷子和传统服饰来描绘亚洲文化。
minority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

minority.sentenceEn: They are often applied to minorities and ethnic people.
minority.translationZh: 它们常常被用于少数群体和 ethnic 人群。

modest.sentenceEn: W: That's very modest of you to say, considering that your four books have sold a total of seven million copies worldwide, and they've been translated into 12 different languages.
modest.translationZh: 您这么说真是太谦虚了。要知道，您的四本书在全球已售出总计七百万册，并被翻译成12种不同的语言。
modest.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

modest.sentenceEn: In my guidelines for saving the environment, I suggest modest changes, like eating vegetarian meals two days a week.
modest.translationZh: 在我提出的环保指南中，我建议进行适度的改变，比如每周吃两天素食。
modest.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

modest.sentenceEn: The company also offers a repair program for their customers for a modest fee.
modest.translationZh: 该公司还为顾客提供收费合理的维修服务。

modest.sentenceEn: Living costs and books I paid for with money earned during high school, supplemented by a small college fund my deceased grandfather left for me and a modest savings account my parents created when I was born.
modest.translationZh: 生活费和书本费我用高中时赚的钱支付，再加上已故祖父留给我的一小笔大学基金，以及父母在我出生时为我设立的一个普通储蓄账户。

modest.sentenceEn: Modest institutions can also have successful graduates and strong alumni networks.
modest.translationZh: 普通院校也能培养出成功的毕业生，并拥有强大的校友网络。

monitoring.sentenceEn: A lot depends on how such monitoring initiatives are communicated and this could prevent possible revolts being staged.
monitoring.translationZh: 这在很大程度上取决于这类监控措施的沟通方式，而良好的沟通可以防止可能发生的反抗行为。
monitoring.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

monitoring.sentenceEn: Although many such monitoring schemes use anonymised data and participation is voluntary, many staffers remain sceptical and fear an erosion of their civil liberties.
monitoring.translationZh: 尽管许多此类监控方案使用匿名数据且参与是自愿的，但不少员工仍持怀疑态度，并担心其公民自由受到侵蚀。
monitoring.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

monitoring.sentenceEn: The majority of cyberloafing research focuses on ways to prevent employees from engaging in this behavior through interventions such as internet monitoring and computer use policies.
monitoring.translationZh: 大多数关于网络摸鱼的研究都侧重于通过互联网监控和计算机使用政策等干预措施来防止员工出现这种行为。
monitoring.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

monitoring.sentenceEn: More than half of companies with over $750m in annual revenue used "non-traditional" monitoring techniques on staff last year.
monitoring.translationZh: 去年，年收入超过7.5亿美元的公司中，有半数以上对员工采用了“非传统”监控手段。
monitoring.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

monitoring.sentenceEn: This year, more than 200 telemedicine-related bills have been introduced in 42 states, many regarding what services Medicaid will cover and whether payers should reimburse for remote patient monitoring .
monitoring.translationZh: 今年，42个州已提出200多项与远程医疗相关的法案，其中许多涉及医疗补助将涵盖哪些服务以及支付方是否应报销远程患者监测费用等问题。

monitoring.sentenceEn: With several monitoring stations operating in Antarctica, Russia is trying hard to counter America's dominance in the field of worldwide navigational facilities.
monitoring.translationZh: 俄罗斯在南极洲运营着多个监测站，正努力挑战美国在全球导航设施领域的主导地位。

mechanism.sentenceEn: While the mechanisms behind these associations are not fully understood, Monteiro argues that the existing evidence is sufficient to justify discouraging consumption of ultra-processed foods in dietary recommendations and government policies.
mechanism.translationZh: 虽然这些关联背后的机制尚未完全明确，但蒙泰罗认为现有证据已足以支持在膳食建议和政府政策中劝阻超加工食品消费。
mechanism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

mechanism.sentenceEn: My research suggests that horror works by exploiting an ancient set of biological defence mechanisms —an evolved fear system, which we share with other animals.
mechanism.translationZh: 我的研究表明，恐怖作品通过利用一套古老的生物防御机制——一种我们与其他动物共有的进化恐惧系统——来产生效果。
mechanism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第2句

mechanism.sentenceEn: Humans were also programmed for something called "compensation," which is the brain's regulatory mechanism for preventing the accumulation of excess weight.
mechanism.translationZh: 人类还进化出了一种被称为“代偿机制”的功能，这是大脑防止体重过度增加的调节机制。
mechanism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

mechanism.sentenceEn: Carriages were replaced, ventilation was improved, and the main depot was also renovated and fitted with connecting tracks to replace the outdated crane transfer mechanism .
mechanism.translationZh: 列车车厢得到更换，通风系统得以改善，主车库也进行了翻新，并铺设了连接轨道，以取代过时的起重机转运机制。
mechanism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

mechanism.sentenceEn: Among human's various abilities, which one has the same mechanism as mental health?
mechanism.translationZh: 在人类的各种能力中，哪一种与心理健康具有相同的机制？

mechanism.sentenceEn: It reminds them of an ancient set of biological defence mechanisms .
mechanism.translationZh: 这让他们想起了一套古老的生物防御机制。

merely.sentenceEn: Astronomer David Chapman explained that this is merely a peculiarity of our calendar; once we stopped doing things based on the moon and started trying to follow the sun and the seasons, we stopped having one reliable full moon per month.
merely.translationZh: 天文学家大卫·查普曼解释说，这只是我们日历的一个特殊之处；一旦我们不再根据月亮行事，而是开始尝试跟随太阳和季节，我们就不再每月有一个可靠的满月了。

merely.sentenceEn: Arguments tend to place different requirements on people in different income brackets and exclude entirely people who are merely making ends meet.
merely.translationZh: 这类论点往往对不同收入阶层的人提出不同要求，而那些仅能维持生计的人则完全被排除在外。
merely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

merely.sentenceEn: For example, some ancient Western philosophers counsel gratitude that is both enduring and complete, and some Eastern thinkers portray it as not merely an attitude but a virtue to be put into practice.
merely.translationZh: 例如，一些古代西方哲学家主张感恩应既持久又全然，而一些东方思想家则将感恩不仅视为一种态度，更看作是一种需要践行的美德。

merely.sentenceEn: Their work offers new insights into the impact word choice has on how we differentiate between statements expressing what is real versus what is merely possible.
merely.translationZh: 他们的研究为我们提供了新的见解，揭示了词汇选择如何影响我们区分表达真实情况的陈述与仅表达可能性的陈述。
merely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

merely.sentenceEn: Thus, it is more important than ever to separate the factual from the possible or merely speculative in how we communicate.
merely.translationZh: 因此，在我们的交流中，区分事实与可能性或纯粹推测比以往任何时候都更加重要。
merely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

merely.sentenceEn: Dementia is different from being merely forgetful and entails more serious trouble.
merely.translationZh: 痴呆不同于单纯的健忘，它意味着更严重的问题。

mindset.sentenceEn: The key to high-level organization is the mindset .
mindset.translationZh: 高水平组织能力的关键在于思维方式。
mindset.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

mindset.sentenceEn: Practicing self-compassion increases your resilience(韧性), emotional intelligence, compassion toward others, and can boost your performance as well as help you develop a growth mindset .
mindset.translationZh: 练习自我同情能增强你的韧性、情商以及对他人的同理心，同时还能提升你的表现，并帮助你培养成长型思维。

mindset.sentenceEn: "We are at a critical crossroads as a species where we must rapidly reform our mindsets and behaviour to act in less selfish ways," he said.
mindset.translationZh: 他说：“作为一个物种，我们正处于关键的十字路口，必须迅速改变思维方式和行为模式，以更少自私的方式行事。”
mindset.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

mindset.sentenceEn: The researchers found that the new words presented to people in a negative mindset were better remembered by people with higher levels of anxiety than those with lower levels of anxiety.
mindset.translationZh: 研究人员发现，对于处于消极心态下接触到的新词汇，焦虑水平较高的人比焦虑水平较低的人记忆得更好。
mindset.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

mindset.sentenceEn: Later, the participants were asked to think back to the words they were shown earlier, which caused them to reenter either a negative or a neutral mindset .
mindset.translationZh: 随后，研究人员要求参与者回想之前看到的词语，这使他们重新进入负面或中性的心态。
mindset.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

mindset.sentenceEn: It is rooted in the mindset of the 17th century.
mindset.translationZh: 它植根于17世纪的思维模式。

mineral.sentenceEn: Today "nutrition is becoming a time bomb", says Azam-Ali, as growing carbon dioxide levels strip crops of their minerals .
mineral.translationZh: 阿扎姆-阿里表示，随着不断上升的二氧化碳水平剥夺了农作物中的矿物质，如今“营养正成为一颗定时炸弹”。

mineral.sentenceEn: From the West Indies also come oil, mineral pitch and many forest products.
mineral.translationZh: 西印度群岛还出产石油、矿物沥青和多种林产品。
mineral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

mineral.sentenceEn: The company boasts that its dried crickets contain more protein than beef, chicken and pork, as well as minerals like iron and calcium.
mineral.translationZh: 该公司宣称，其干蟋蟀不仅含有比牛肉、鸡肉和猪肉更多的蛋白质，还富含铁和钙等矿物质。
mineral.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

mineral.sentenceEn: But there are also many examples of growing wealth by trashing the environment, in rich and poor parts of the world alike, whether through unregulated mineral extraction, drastic water use for agriculture, slash-and-burn farming, or fossil-fuel-guzzling(大量消耗) transport.
mineral.translationZh: 但世界上无论是富裕地区还是贫困地区，也有许多通过破坏环境来积累财富的例子，比如无节制的矿产开采、农业用水的过度消耗、刀耕火种的耕作方式，或是对化石燃料消耗巨大的交通运输。

mineral.sentenceEn: Then there is Antarctica's remoteness, with some mineral deposits found in windswept locations on a continent that is larger than Europe and where winter temperatures hover around minus 55 degrees Celsius.
mineral.translationZh: 此外，南极洲地理位置偏远，一些矿藏位于狂风肆虐的地区。这片大陆面积比欧洲还要大，冬季气温低至零下55摄氏度左右。

mineral.sentenceEn: It relies chiefly on mineral export.

monument.sentenceEn: "We've been saying for years that the budget for maintaining historic monuments is too low," Gady said.
monument.translationZh: 加迪表示：“多年来我们一直在说，用于维护历史古迹的预算实在太低了。”

monument.sentenceEn: A greater disaster was averted by members of the Paris fire brigade, who risked their lives to remain inside the burning monument to create a wall of water between the raging fire and the two towers on the west of the building.
monument.translationZh: 巴黎消防队队员冒着生命危险坚守在这座燃烧的建筑内，在熊熊大火与西侧两座塔楼之间筑起一道水墙，从而避免了一场更大的灾难。

monument.sentenceEn: The revelation of how close France came to losing its most famous cathedral emerged as police investigators questioned workers involved in the restoration of the monument to try to establish the cause of the devastating blaze.
monument.translationZh: 随着警方调查人员询问参与大教堂修复工作的工人，试图查明这场毁灭性大火的原因，法国曾何等接近失去其最著名大教堂的真相也随之浮出水面。

monument.sentenceEn: Leniaud told La Croix newspaper: "This is not about looking for people to blame. The responsibility is collective because this is the most loved monument in the country."
monument.translationZh: 勒尼奥在接受《十字架报》采访时表示：“这不是要追究谁的责任。责任是集体性的，因为这是这个国家最受爱戴的纪念碑。”

monument.sentenceEn: The partial skeletons of more than 20 dinosaurs and the scattered bones of about 300 more have been discovered in Utah and Colorado at what is now the Dinosaur National Monument .
monument.translationZh: 在犹他州和科罗拉多州，如今的恐龙国家纪念公园内，已发现20多具恐龙的部分骨骼和大约300多块散落的骨头。
monument.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

monument.sentenceEn: It lay 8 miles from the monument sites.
monument.translationZh: 这条路距离那些纪念碑遗址有8英里远。

motor.sentenceEn: Strong social connections are important for cognitive functioning, motor function and a smoothly running immune system.
motor.translationZh: 良好的社会关系对认知功能、运动功能和免疫系统的正常运作都很重要。

motor.sentenceEn: In 1920, the first three-color light system was introduced in Detroit — also known as Motor City, USA.
motor.translationZh: 1920年，第一套三色信号灯系统在底特律问世，底特律也被称为美国的“汽车城”。

motor.sentenceEn: Unlike most European cities that started urban planning when horses were high-tech, many cities in the United States were designed around urban sprawl, suburban tracts, and motor cars.
motor.translationZh: 多数欧洲城市在马车还是高科技的年代就已开启城市规划，与之不同，美国的许多城市则是围绕城市扩张、郊区地块和汽车进行设计的。

motor.sentenceEn: The evolution of traffic light signals could not have a more appropriate context than Motor City.
motor.translationZh: 交通信号灯的演进，没有比在‘汽车之城’更合适的背景了。

motor.sentenceEn: Ford Motor Company was founded in Detroit in 1903 (and other motor companies followed).
motor.translationZh: 福特汽车公司于 1903 年在底特律成立（随后其他汽车公司也相继成立）。

motor.sentenceEn: It is operated by a special type of tiny motor .
motor.translationZh: 它由一种特殊类型的微型电机驱动。

medication.sentenceEn: This happens when bacteria develop the ability to survive the medications designed to kill them.
medication.translationZh: 当细菌进化出在本应杀死它们的药物作用下存活的能力时，就会产生这种耐药性。
medication.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

medication.sentenceEn: The woman, who later turned out to be a schizophrenic(精神分裂症患者) without access to her medications , was, by some force, wrestled out and escorted away, then put in a hospital for observation, in a step that was actually safer for everyone than any one of us pressing charges.
medication.translationZh: 后来发现，这名女子是一名无法获得药物治疗的精神分裂症患者。有人强行将她架了出去，护送离开，随后送往医院观察。实际上，这一处理方式比我们任何人提出指控都更能保障所有人的安全。
medication.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

medication.sentenceEn: This is especially true with issues related to public health, like the safety of new medications and the benefits of vaccines.
medication.translationZh: 在涉及公共卫生的问题上尤其如此，比如新药的安全性和疫苗的益处。
medication.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

medication.sentenceEn: In 62 encounters, fewer than one-third disclosed clinicians' credentials or let patients choose; only 32% discussed potential side effects of prescribed medications .
medication.translationZh: 在62次问诊中，不到三分之一的平台会披露临床医生的资质或让患者进行选择；只有32%的平台会讨论处方药的潜在副作用。

medication.sentenceEn: Toyohashi University of Technology has developed Terapio, a robotic medical cart that can make hospital rounds, deliver medications and other items, and retrieve records.
medication.translationZh: 丰桥技术大学研发了Terapio，这是一种医疗机器人推车，能够在医院巡房、运送药品和其他物品，并调取记录。
medication.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

medication.sentenceEn: Medication is available for treating loneliness.
medication.translationZh: 目前已有治疗孤独的药物。

migration.sentenceEn: To keep up with migration patterns, postal services were added to existing businesses.
migration.translationZh: 为了跟上移民潮的步伐，邮局服务被增设到了现有的各类商户中。
migration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

migration.sentenceEn: You will hear more and more about migration between countries, and between rural areas and cities.
migration.translationZh: 你将会越来越多地听到关于国家之间以及城乡之间的人口迁移问题。
migration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

migration.sentenceEn: Researchers in Germany used miniature GPS tags to track the migrations of 70 white storks(鹳) from different sites across Europe and Asia during the first five months of their lives.
migration.translationZh: 德国研究人员使用微型GPS标签追踪了70只白鹳在其生命最初五个月内的迁徙情况，这些白鹳来自欧洲和亚洲的不同地区。
migration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

migration.sentenceEn: Andrea Flack of the Max Planck Institute found that birds following traditional migration routes were more likely to die than German storks that flew only as far as northern Morocco, and spent the winter there on rubbish dumps.
migration.translationZh: 马克斯·普朗克研究所的安德里亚·弗拉克发现，遵循传统迁徙路线的鹳比那些仅飞到摩洛哥北部并在那里的垃圾场过冬的德国鹳更容易死亡。
migration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

migration.sentenceEn: What do we learn about birds following the traditional migration routes?
migration.translationZh: 关于遵循传统迁徙路线的鸟类，我们了解到什么？

migration.sentenceEn: There must have been some reason for human migration .
migration.translationZh: 人类的迁徙一定存在某种原因。

missing.sentenceEn: It takes about three months to go from " missing in action" to "irretrievably lost".
missing.translationZh: 从“失踪”到“彻底无法找回”大约需要三个月的时间。
missing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

missing.sentenceEn: Every year, of the more than 2.5 billion bags checked onto flights worldwide, 26 million go missing — and of that 26 million, 1 million never make it back to their original owner.
missing.translationZh: 全球每年有超过 25 亿件行李托运，其中 2600 万件会丢失——而在丢失的 2600 万件中，有 100 万件永远无法回到原主人的手中。
missing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

missing.sentenceEn: Once a bag goes missing and the passenger files a claim, the bag is declared "mishandled" by the carrier.
missing.translationZh: 一旦行李丢失且旅客提交了索赔申请，承运人便会将该行李标记为“处理不当”。
missing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

missing.sentenceEn: But missing from all these data is the sense that today's young care very much about their country, about the broader civic and political environment, or about the future of their society.
missing.translationZh: 但所有这些数据都缺少了一种感觉，即如今的年轻人非常关心他们的国家、更广泛的公民和政治环境，或是他们社会的未来。

missing.sentenceEn: Missing from these bills is any serious attempt to rein in malpractice costs.
missing.translationZh: 这些法案都未能认真尝试控制医疗事故成本。

missing.sentenceEn: Contact the airport staff to find our missing bag.
missing.translationZh: 联系机场工作人员寻找我们丢失的行李。

moderate.sentenceEn: The researchers concede that this research was about changes to mostly moderate beliefs—it's likely the findings would be different in the context of changes to extreme or deeply held beliefs.
moderate.translationZh: 研究人员承认，这项研究主要关注的是对中度信念的改变——如果研究对象是极端或根深蒂固的信念变化，结果很可能会有所不同。
moderate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

moderate.sentenceEn: However, our beliefs on most topics are in the moderate range, and as we go about our daily lives reading informative material, these intriguing findings suggest we are mostly ignorant of how what we just read has updated and altered our own position.
moderate.translationZh: 然而，我们对大多数话题的看法都处于温和范围，而当我们在日常生活中阅读信息性材料时，这些有趣的研究结果表明，我们大多不知道刚刚阅读的内容如何更新和改变了我们自己的立场。
moderate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

moderate.sentenceEn: Even comparatively moderate salaries in the west are very high when compared globally.
moderate.translationZh: 即便是西方相对普通的薪资，放到全球范围来看也相当高。
moderate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

moderate.sentenceEn: Stress is often depicted as negative, but research shows that moderate amounts of it can be beneficial for your brain and your body.
moderate.translationZh: 压力常被描绘成负面的，但研究表明适量的压力对大脑和身体都有益处。
moderate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

moderate.sentenceEn: One useful way is to distinguish between three degrees of poverty: extreme poverty, moderate poverty, and relative poverty.
moderate.translationZh: 一种有用的方法是区分贫困的三个程度：极端贫困、中度贫困和相对贫困。
moderate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

moderate.sentenceEn: They apparently have little to do with moderate beliefs.
moderate.translationZh: 它们显然与温和的信念没什么关系。

modify.sentenceEn: If either partner fairly consistently predominates or evaporates, modifying the pattern will be helpful.
modify.translationZh: 如果伴侣中任何一方长期占据主导地位或过度退让，调整相处模式将会有所帮助。
modify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

modify.sentenceEn: But scientists who want to communicate with the general public need to modify their language.
modify.translationZh: 但是想要与普通大众交流的科学家需要调整他们的语言表达方式。
modify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

modify.sentenceEn: She says she is aware that plenty of people do not want to eat genetically modified crops, but she is pushing ahead with every available tool until one works.
modify.translationZh: 她说她知道很多人不愿意食用转基因作物，但她仍在尝试所有可用的方法，直到找到一种可行的方案。

modify.sentenceEn: One relatively simple fix, Mr. Zdziarski said, would be for Apple to modify future versions of the iPhone to require a user to enter a passcode before the phone will accept the sort of modified operating system that the FBI wants Apple to create.
modify.translationZh: 兹迪亚尔斯基先生表示，一个相对简单的解决方案是，苹果可以对未来版本的iPhone进行修改，要求用户输入密码后，手机才会接受FBI希望苹果创建的那种修改版操作系统。

modify.sentenceEn: Piaget argued that attaining and accepting a vocation is one of the best ways to modify idealized views and to mature.
modify.translationZh: 皮亚杰认为，获得并接受一份职业是修正理想化观点并走向成熟的最佳途径之一。
modify.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

modify.translationZh: 他们可能会改变自己的行为。

motivated.sentenceEn: "Once he decides to do it, it's usually something that's going to happen. He's always been like that. He's a very motivated individual."
motivated.translationZh: 他一旦下定决心要做某件事，通常就一定会做到。他一直都是这样。他是个非常有行动力的人。

motivated.sentenceEn: And yet despite how these employees feel, it's obviously important for their manager to nonetheless find out how to keep them motivated .
motivated.translationZh: 然而，不管这些员工内心作何感想，他们的管理者显然仍需要找到激励他们的方法。
motivated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

motivated.sentenceEn: Government action works when individuals are motivated to respond.
motivated.translationZh: 只有当个人有动力做出回应时，政府行动才能奏效。
motivated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

motivated.sentenceEn: More recently, as he reported in a 2012 review, Lieberman has discovered that this region may be part of a distinct network involved in socially motivated learning and memory.
motivated.translationZh: 利伯曼在2012年的一篇综述中报告称，他最近发现该区域可能是参与社会动机学习和记忆的一个独特网络的组成部分。

motivated.sentenceEn: It seems commonly believed that companies are not motivated to prolong their products' lifespan.
motivated.translationZh: 人们普遍认为，企业没有动力延长其产品的使用寿命。

motivated.sentenceEn: Sprinkling in a little phonics deters the progress of even adequately motivated children.
motivated.translationZh: 零散地教一点 phonics 甚至会阻碍那些学习动机足够强的孩子的进步。

multiply.sentenceEn: When your brain cells multiply , your memory can improve.
multiply.translationZh: 当你的脑细胞增多时，记忆力就会提升。
multiply.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第8句

multiply.sentenceEn: In recent decades, environmental threats have expanded beyond regional boundaries to have global reach and, most hauntingly, are multiplying at a dizzying rate.
multiply.translationZh: 近几十年来，环境威胁已超越区域界限，蔓延至全球范围，而最令人不安的是，其增长速度快得令人眩晕。
关于加速灾难的报道越来越多。

multiply.sentenceEn: The number of devices you can talk to is multiplying —first it was your phone, then your car, and now you can tell your kitchen appliance what to do.
multiply.translationZh: 你可以与之对话的设备数量正在不断增加——起初是手机，然后是汽车，现在你甚至可以吩咐厨房电器该做什么。
multiply.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

multiply.sentenceEn: What has caused claims of huge structural problems to multiply ?
multiply.translationZh: 是什么导致有关巨大结构性问题的说法日益增多？

multiply.sentenceEn: It multiplies at a speed beyond human imagination.
multiply.translationZh: 它的繁殖速度超乎人类想象。

mall.sentenceEn: Like a major department store in a mall , libraries attract large numbers of people, creating economic opportunities for numerous businesses and organizations in the surrounding area.
mall.translationZh: 图书馆如同商场中的大型百货公司，吸引着大量人群，为周边地区的众多企业和机构创造了经济机会。

mall.sentenceEn: Think of it this way: If you forget where you parked your car at the mall , that's normal; if you forget how to drive a car, that may be a signal that something more serious is going on.
mall.translationZh: 可以这样理解：如果你忘记在商场把车停在哪里了，这很正常；但如果你忘记如何开车了，这可能就预示着更严重的问题。

mall.sentenceEn: Or head out to the mall , or Main Street, look and shop, and buy.
mall.translationZh: 或者前往商场，或商业街，浏览、购物并购买商品。

mall.sentenceEn: The big questions are which, if any, of the large traditional retailers will still be on the scene in a decade or two because they have successfully reinvented themselves, which new players will operate busy stores on Main Streets and maybe even in shopping malls , and how the shopping and buying experience will have changed in each retail category.
mall.translationZh: 核心问题在于：哪些大型传统零售商（如果有的话）能够通过成功转型在未来十年或二十年后依然屹立不倒；哪些新兴力量将在商业街甚至购物中心开设客流兴旺的店铺；以及各类零售业态中的购物体验将发生怎样的变化。

mall.sentenceEn: However, Fortune says the weakest of the malls have closed.
mall.translationZh: 然而，《财富》杂志表示，那些经营最困难的商场已经关闭。
mall.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

mall.sentenceEn: What does Fortune say about traditional shopping malls ?
mall.translationZh: 《财富》杂志对传统购物中心有何评价？

mammal.sentenceEn: As one example, the energy in plants that livestock consume is most often contained in cellulose(纤维素), which is indigestible for humans and many other mammals .
mammal.translationZh: 例如，牲畜食用的植物能量通常存在于纤维素中，而纤维素对于人类和许多其他哺乳动物来说是无法消化的。

mammal.sentenceEn: Many scientists believe that earth has now entered the sixth mass extinction, with humans creating a toxic mix of habitat loss, pollution and climate change, which has already led to the loss of at least 77 species of mammals and 140 types of birds since 1500.
mammal.translationZh: 许多科学家认为地球现已进入第六次大规模灭绝时期，人类造成的栖息地丧失、污染和气候变化等不利因素相互交织，自1500年以来已导致至少77种哺乳动物和140种鸟类灭绝。
mammal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

mammal.sentenceEn: Imagine you're an alien sent to Earth to document the behaviour of the mammals inhabiting the planet.
mammal.translationZh: 想象一下，你是一名被派往地球的外星人，任务是记录这个星球上哺乳动物的行为。
mammal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

mammal.sentenceEn: At more than 7 billion, human population dwarfs that of nearly all other mammals —despite our physical weaknesses.
mammal.translationZh: 尽管人类在体能上存在弱点，但全球人口已超过70亿，这一数字令几乎所有其他哺乳动物的种群数量都相形见绌。
mammal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

mammal.sentenceEn: You probably remember that human infants are less developed physically than other mammals of the same age.
mammal.translationZh: 你们可能还记得，人类婴儿的身体发育程度低于同龄的其他哺乳动物。
mammal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

mammal.sentenceEn: What might explain humans' having the largest population of almost all mammals ?
mammal.translationZh: 是什么可以解释人类拥有几乎所有哺乳动物中最多的数量？

marketer.sentenceEn: Marketers need to figure out ways to speak directly to the customers' emotions, and they need to figure out how to do that as quickly as possible.
marketer.translationZh: 营销人员需要找到直接触动客户情感的方法，并且需要尽快做到这一点。
marketer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

marketer.sentenceEn: That's why it's important for marketers to pay attention to the latest technological developments and consider collaborating with technological innovators.
marketer.translationZh: 这就是为什么营销人员必须关注最新的技术发展，并考虑与技术创新者合作。
marketer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

marketer.sentenceEn: Marketers have to do research on which technologies are coming into being.
marketer.translationZh: 营销人员必须研究正在兴起的各类技术。
marketer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

marketer.sentenceEn: In a recent survey, only 9% of marketers could say with confidence that their marketing efforts were actually working.
marketer.translationZh: 在最近的一项调查中，只有9%的营销人员能够自信地说他们的营销工作确实有效。
marketer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

marketer.sentenceEn: We seem to take it for granted that advertisers and marketers are allowed to condition even the youngest children.
marketer.translationZh: 我们似乎想当然地认为，广告商和营销人员甚至被允许影响年幼的儿童。
marketer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

marketer.sentenceEn: What does the speaker suggest marketers do to meet future challenges?
marketer.translationZh: 演讲者建议营销人员如何应对未来的挑战？

mathematical.sentenceEn: The app's mathematical approach can arrange a more meticulous workout schedule.
mathematical.translationZh: 这款应用的数学算法能够制定出更细致的锻炼计划。
mathematical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第14句

mathematical.sentenceEn: He'll use those data to validate and improve his mathematical flooding model, called TideWatch.
mathematical.translationZh: 他将利用这些数据来验证并改进其名为TideWatch的洪水数学模型。
mathematical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

mathematical.sentenceEn: And while a 2014 report from German and American universities suggests that programmers are using language (but not mathematical ) regions of the brain when understanding code, critics remain wary.
